::: text
Welcome to my personal website!

I have a PhD in Chemical Engineering, and a Masters in Statistics, both from UT Austin. I have hands-on experience in metabolic engineering, synthetic biology, bioprocess development, statistical modeling, and bioinformatics. I have a Bachelor's in Chemical-Biological Engineering from MIT. Broadly, I'm interested in research at the intersection of engineering, life sciences, and statistics.
